description: This file defines the ShiftType class and related functions for managing shift attendance, including processing auto-attendance, calculating attendance status, and handling absent marking within an HR module.

classes.name: ShiftType
classes.description: Represents a shift type with methods to process auto-attendance, calculate attendance, and mark absences.

methods.name: process_auto_attendance
methods.description: Processes auto-attendance for the shift, fetching logs and marking attendance accordingly.

methods.name: get_attendance
methods.description: Calculates attendance status, working hours, and lateness/early exit flags based on logs.

methods.name: mark_absent_for_dates_with_no_attendance
methods.description: Marks absent attendance for employees on days with no attendance records within the shift.

methods.name: get_assigned_employee
methods.description: Retrieves employees assigned to the shift, optionally considering default shift assignments.
